headline: Orders outpace shipments as growth accelerates
summary_short: Revenue rose 8% y/y to $2.2B (+7% organic), adjusted EPS was $2.88 (+10%), and bookings of $2.3B rose about 15.5% y/y.
summary_long: Bookings increased in all five segments and outpaced shipments; a significant portion of backlog is scheduled for 2027 delivery. Growth was led by AI and power generation infrastructure, energy transition, single-use biopharma, semiconductors and space launch. Dover repurchased over $330M of shares and announced two bolt-on acquisitions. Full-year 2026 guidance: adjusted EPS $10.60-$10.75 on 7%-8% revenue growth (5%-6% organic).
confidence_notes: EPS figures are from continuing operations per the release; the shard's EPS values include a small discontinued-operations loss (net diluted $2.47). Bookings y/y is computed from the release's own quarterly table ($2,310.1M vs $1,999.7M). Adjusted EPS is non-GAAP.

drivers.explanation: Growth was led by secular markets including AI and power generation infrastructure, energy transition, single-use biopharma, semiconductor manufacturing and space launch, plus improving food retail line rates.
Bookings rose across all five segments and again outpaced shipments, according to the CEO.
CEO says Dover is on track for double-digit adjusted EPS growth in 2026.
